note: Docs whose #117 markdown migration REVIVED a name the live HTML had ALREADY renamed away — a migration regression, not new content. The seed can't thread them (their true predecessor lives under the NEW name and is degenerate among identical-body siblings), so with the base architecture they ship as a bare seam:'created' ('introduced here'). This hand-authored ledger (found via git-history forensics) re-tags each #117 md doc, by UUID, as seam:'reintroduced' and links back to the HTML commit where the prior name was retired + the true predecessor occurrence — so the reconstruction records 'revived, not born'. Consumed by scripts/aux/prepare-html-history.mjs (additive; only the listed UUIDs). See scripts/aux/HISTORY.md § Re-introductions.
